value.expr: if(len(data) > 0, [{name: name, data: data}], []) + map(series, s => {name: s.name, data: s.data})

values.name: ylo

max(ceil(yhi/ystep) ystep, yhi + if(yhi > ylo, 0, ystep))

values.name: xlo
comment: x: bars get a band around each x; marks get a little room at the ends

value.expr: if(len(ux) > 1, min(map(range(1, len(ux) - 1), k => ux[k] - ux[k - 1])), 1)
if(kind == bar, band/2, if(kind == dot or kind == stem, max(band/2, (xhi - xlo)/25), if(xhi > xlo, 0, 1)))
if(len(cats) > 0 or (kind == bar and len(ux) <= 16), ux, ticks(xlo, xhi, nicestep(max(xhi - xlo, 1)/5)))

values.name: X
comment: the plot area inside a 100 × 62 canvas, leaving room for tick labels

value.expr: kind == dot or kind == stem or (kind == line and len(pts) <= 30 ns)

values.name: bw
